title: Photo isn’t accurate!
text: Photo isn’t accurate!. I bought the pack of 3 caddy’s and it shows them with 3 sets of hooks to support the caddy’s. I installed mine and the. Realized my stickers only came with 2 hooks. I doubt this will be enough to hold the weight of shampoo bottles. You should get what is advertised in the photos.

product_metadata.title: Nieifi Shower Caddy Basket with Hooks Soap Dish Holder Shelf for Shampoo Conditioner Bathroom Kitchen Storage Organizer SUS304 Stainless Steel Adhesive No Drilling - 3 Pack
